dct_title_s: A mapp of Europe: designed by Mounsieur Sanson, geographer to the French king, and rendred into English and illustrated by Ric: Blome, by his Majets. espesiall command
dct_alternative_sm: A mapp of Europe: designed by Mounsieur Sanson, geographer to the French king, and rendred into English and illustrated by Ric: Blome, by his Majets. espesiall command
dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.; Title in decorative cartouche with heralds, horseback riders, and drummers.; Includes illustrations of sailing ships and sea monsters.; From Blome's Geographical description of the four parts of the world (1667).; In heraldic cartouche with the crest of England: "To the high and Mighty Prince James, Duke of Yorke & Albany, Marquesse of Ormond, Earle of Ross, Ld. of Aramanoch, Ld. High Admirall of England, Kt. of the most noble order of the Garter, sole Brother & Privi Councellor to his most Sacrid Ma:ty K. Charles the 2, this Mapp is humbly Dedicated by Rich:r Blome". "Printed for Rich. Blome (London)"
39 x 56 centimeters on sheet 45 x 60 centimeters
